section.div: A custom Jellyfin skin that I use, inspired from Ultrachromic and Zombie Theme.

A small self-built GitHub bot that checks package.json, requirements.txt, pyproject.toml, go.mod, Cargo.toml, Gemfile, and composer.json for outdated dependencies. Opens grouped, labeled PRs with security-advisory notes and optional auto-merge — a minimal Renovate/Dependabot alternative built on the GitHub REST/GraphQL API.
API error: 403 (The AniList API has been temporarily disabled due to severe stability issues.)
